Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Aarav - 9 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Anita - 37 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Kavya - 12 years, friend
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair
4. Siya - 10 years, daughter
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail
5. Vimla - 66 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots
3. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Aarav stands in the living room. Anita and Vimla stand near him.]

Aarav: "Mom, what's the plan today?"

[Aarav sweeps the floor with a broom.]

Aarav: "How beautiful!"

[Aarav mops the floor.]

Aarav: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Aarav irons his school shirt.]

Aarav: "Slowly, take it easy."

Scene 2: The kitchen - Day

[Aarav stands in the kitchen. Anita and Kavya stand near him.]

Anita: "So, here we are!"

[Aarav makes tea for everyone.]

Anita: "What happened?"

[Aarav chops onions for the curry.]

Kavya: "Yes, of course."

[Aarav washes the dishes after dinner.]

Kavya: "What happened?"

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

[Aarav stands in the courtyard. Anita and Siya stand near him.]

Aarav: "Let's begin."

[Aarav runs to Mother.]

Anita: "I knew it!"

[Aarav jumps with joy.]

Aarav (softly): "I knew it!"

[Aarav climbs the stairs to the terrace.]

Aarav: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
